objective: Offer English teachers a usable L/N listening warm-up and introduce the maintainer's optional practice app.

reddit.title: A light/night listening warm-up, plus the L/N practice app I built
reddit.content:
One small exercise for adult learners who mix up L and N: write "light" and "night" where both are visible, say a short random sequence, and have the learner point to each word they hear before trying to say it.

Then swap roles: the learner says one of the words and you point to the one you heard. That gives you listening and speaking to work on separately.

I built L & N: Speech Practice because I mix these sounds up myself. It has short listening rounds and single-word recording practice, with feedback showing what the recognizer heard. No account needed. The score is practice feedback, not something I'd use to grade a student.

iPhone/iPad — US$0.99: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/l-n-speech-practice/id6808872450

Android — free download, with in-app purchases: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=art.lazying.landn
